messages:
Rohit: Dropping a draft one-pager and two short benchmark narratives for a new field brief called 'ShieldStart' — focused on secure inference + deploy modes. Need quick eyes on webinar blurb, inbound routing tags, and the short social post. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/shieldstart (privileged).

Maya: Nice — quick Q: who is the primary audience here? platform engineers, infra/security, or field CISOs? I think we should have two lead lines.

Liz: Aim for CISO + infra. I can tighten the security TL;DR. Also we should call out a clear metric up front. The deck mentions latency & cost wins — what numbers do we want in the one-pager headline?

Ben: Benchmarks came from Dedicated pool runs with caching + quantization. Typical wins range 40–55% on cost-per-token and 20–45% on 95th pct latency depending on model and q-config. Suggest we use conservative "~40% cost" for the one-pager.

Sam: @Rohit routing note — please add inbound tags so leads get triaged to sales-eng. Suggested tags: enterprise, secure-deploy, ShieldStart, demo-request. Also we need a CTA that routes 'bring-your-workload' evaluation requests to field.

Rohit: Good recs. Proposed inbound routing snippet to embed in ops doc:
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","secure-deploy","ShieldStart","SLA"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: demo-request
  intake_note: "attach workload sample or perf target"
```

Maya: :eyes: Can we split secure-deploy into more specific campaign tags like 'vpc' and 'onprem' so field can filter by deployment mode? Also include 'SLA' as you put above.

Liz: I'll PR copy to call out the SLA clearly: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Hosted: best-effort with regional fallback." Sound right?

Ben: Yep — that aligns with current product guarantees. Add a brief footnote about fallback policies & automatic model variant routing when capacity constrained.

Rohit: Draft webinar blurb (short): "Predictable LLM inference for security-conscious teams." Longer line: "Building low-latency, compliant inference at scale — how ShieldStart delivers predictable SLAs, cost controls, and private deployment options." Feedback?

Maya: Short headline is great for social. For the webinar description, can we add a quick agenda line: 1) architecture & SLAs 2) benchmark deep-dive 3) customer evaluation kit walkthrough.

Sam: Add explicit CTA: "Bring your workload — request a free evaluation kit" and route those to the demo funnel. Also request a slide with sales play steps (discovery checklist + pricing appendix).

Liz: I'll push copy edits to the one-pager and add an SLA callout by EOD. Ben — can you attach the benchmark figures (PNG + short table) so I can reference them in the doc?

Ben: On it. I'll also include a small table snippet for the one-pager showing avg token cost comparisons and 95th pct latency numbers.

ops-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot request submitted for 2026-05-12 09:00 PT — request ID 3214.

Rohit: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll publish the internal brief and route to field tomorrow AM. Final checklist: copy (Liz), benchmarks (Ben), routing tags (me + Sam), webinar blurb + social headline (Maya). :thumbsup:
